title: Intel’s Rosy Results Still Leave Questions About Customers
description: Intel Corp.’s upbeat quarterly report, which handily beat Wall Street estimates, still left a major question: how soon the chipmaker will line up outside customers for its factories.

title: CFTC Warns Prediction Markets Over Blanket Self-Certifications
description: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission is tapping the brakes on prediction markets’ practice of “self-certifying” boilerplate contracts that could apply to myriad events.

title: Google Ordered to Defend Robby Starbuck’s AI Defamation Suit
description: Alphabet Inc.'s Google LLC lost its bid Friday to escape a court case dangling the specter of legal liability for false statements made by an artificial intelligence chatbot.
